EmailTemplate.description: Sent to a Contact or Lead when an identity verification is requested. Includes the verification link and plain-text fallback URL.
EmailTemplate.name: Incode Verification Request
EmailTemplate.subject: Action Required: Complete Your Business Verification
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Hi {!Contact.FirstName},
ACTION REQUIRED: Complete Your Business Verification ----------------------------------------------------
To complete your onboarding, we need to verify your business through our eKYB (electronic Know Your Business) process. This is a standard requirement under financial regulations and Anti-Money Laundering (AML) compliance policies.
WHAT TO EXPECT: - Confirm your business name, tax ID, and registered address - Provide beneficial ownership (UBO) information if applicable - Takes approximately 5 minutes to complete - All data is encrypted and processed securely
To complete your business verification, please visit: {!Incode_Verification__c.Verification_URL__c}
---------------------------------------------------- SECURITY NOTICE: This link is personal to you and expires after a single use. Do not share it with anyone. If you were not expecting this message, please disregard it or contact our support team immediately.
